title: Rattan Chand Hira Chand v Askar Nawaz Jung

content.caseIdentity: Rattan Chand Hira Chand v Askar Nawaz Jung, (1991) 3 SCC 67
content.facts: Indian law does not make every champertous bargain void; enforceability depends on public policy, justice, equity, good conscience and applicable contract law.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Indian law does not make every champertous bargain void; enforceability depends on public policy, justice, equity, good conscience and applicable contract law.
content.holding: Indian law does not make every champertous bargain void; enforceability depends on public policy, justice, equity, good conscience and applicable contract law.
